name: Eggplant, Tomato & Chickpea Stew with Couscous & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggplants
1 ½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and discard the ends of the eggplants; medium dice the eggplants (cut into 1 ¼-cm cubes) and transfer to a large bowl.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion (cut into 6-mm cubes).
Add olive oil to the pan and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the onion to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Peel and mince (or crush) the garlic.
Add broth to a small saucepan and bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message: 710 ml (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Add the garlic to the pan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.

Add the eggplant, diced tomatoes, and broth to the pan; season with cumin, salt, pepper, and curry powder. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low; cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggplant is tender, 8 to 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
355 ml (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp cumin
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp curry powder

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, remove the saucepan from the heat. Add salt and couscous and stir. Cover the saucepan and let it sit for 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
1 ½ cups whole wheat couscous

instructions.primary_message: While the eggplant cooks, drain and rinse the chickpeas in a colander.
Place the feta in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and chop almost all of the leaves (save a few for garnishing).
Stir the chickpeas and chopped basil into the pan; cook for another 2 to 3 minutes.
Uncover the couscous and fluff with a fork.
To serve, spoon the couscous onto a plate, top with the stew, and garnish with the feta and remaining basil leaves. Enjoy!
